items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He and Charlie Rouse were the ultimate sharp saxophone players. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Uh-huh, Charlie Rouse.

ctx.x: He and Charlie Rouse were the ultimate sharp saxophone players.
Uh-huh, Charlie Rouse. Bird was pretty sharp at the beginning, and Sonny Rollins.
